evidence.quote: These services scale with each elastic network interface you create in your VPC, and each network interface allows 1024 packets per second (PPS) destined to Link-Local services. Packets exceeding this limit are rejected.
Link-Local services include Route 53 VPC Resolver, Amazon Time Service (NTP), Instance Metadata Service (IMDS) and Windows Licensing Service (for Windows instances).
